summary: A regulatory and legal-heavy morning with FSSAI enforcement action against a major consumer brand and significant judicial rulings on court procedures. Reliance's Jio begins investor roadshow ahead of potential listing.

bullets.text: FSSAI filed three adjudication cases against Nestlé India over '5 HMOs' and 'easy-to-digest' whey claims in infant nutrition products.
Madras HC ruled physical witness presence unnecessary for examination if video conferencing enables proper cross-examination.
Supreme Court stated it is not in favour of setting deadlines for High Courts to decide cases.
L Catterton acquired minority stake in South India restaurant chain Nandhana Foods for $30 million.
Reliance Jio began investor meetings ahead of planned listing; NSE also eyeing IPO.
